description: Builds a warm rotation, WarmInboxes' method: the inboxes split into Batch 1 and Batch 2, both tagged in the sequencer and added to the campaign, the active batch at full daily limits while the resting batch sends follow-ups only, swapped by changing the limits on each tag. The swap cycle follows the sequence length (sequenceDays: up to 7 days weekly, up to 14 every two weeks, longer monthly). Returns batch sizes, the cycle and why, the setup steps, how to rotate lead lists between the batches, the daily load per active inbox against a 15-a-day pace, how many inboxes the volume needs, and an eight-week calendar. Use it for anyone asking how to rotate inboxes, keep inboxes and domains alive longer, or send into saturated niches such as ecommerce, SaaS or healthcare. A suggested plan only: it changes no inbox or sequencer.

cadenceWeeks.description: Weeks between swaps, to override the cycle sequenceDays sets. Defaults to 2 when neither is given.

sequenceDays.description: Days from the first step of the sequence to the last. Sets the swap cycle: up to 7 weekly, up to 14 every two weeks, longer monthly.
